newsitem.title: USA: Vista Medical lowers IPO price range.
newsitem.headline: Vista Medical lowers IPO price range.

text.p: Vista Medical Technologies Inc on Wednesday lowered the estimated price range of its planned initial public stock offering to $8 to $10, according to lead underwriter Goldman Sachs & Co.
Previously, the estimated price range for the offering of 3.5 million shares was $11 to $13. The company expects to begin Nasdaq trading on July 1 under the symbol "VMTI."
Vista, based in Carlsbad, California, develops, manufactures and intends to market visualization and information systems to be used in minimally invasive surgical procedures.
